description_en: Creates an account by calling the CreateAccount operation
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx create-account --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-00000000000000 --account-name testAccount --account-password Test@1111 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en: The region where the instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the account to be created
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the account to be created
parameters.help_zh: 待创建账号的账号密码
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en: The name of the database to be authorized
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The permissions to be granted to the new account on the specified database. Valid values:

ReadWrite
ReadOnly
DMLOnly
DDLOnly
parameters.help_zh:
给新创建的账号授权某数据库的权限，包括：

ReadWrite
ReadOnly
DMLOnly
DDLOnly
parameters.name: account_privilege

parameters.help_en:
The name of the security administrator account.

If the three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. If the three-role mode is not enabled, this parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
安全管理员账号名称。

若已开启三权分立模式，该参数必填，未开启三权分立可以不填
parameters.name: security_account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the security administrator account.

If the three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. If the three-role mode is not enabled, this parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
安全管理员账号密码。

若已开启三权分立模式，该参数必填，未开启三权分立可以不填
parameters.name: security_account_password

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is empty if the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 成功为空，失败为报错信息

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
